name: Artificial After All
description: The sold-out factory that created 256 Artificial pieces, each a sovereign onchain generative artwork contract.
about:
## About

Artificial After All (2026) is the factory contract by Han that created the Artificial series. Each mint deployed a new, fully independent `Artificial` contract — one of 256 sovereign pieces, each holding a compressed neural network, an inference engine, and its own built-in marketplace onchain (see 0xbdf5a7f5e5ae18ee580139297c63a89fc1d18b5f for one piece).

## Minting

The 256-piece edition is sold out, so `createArtificial()` now reverts with `SoldOut`. The first 64 pieces were reserved for the artist and minted for free; the remaining pieces minted for a fixed 0.128 ETH each. On each mint the factory derived a seed from the block randomness, the minter, and the count, deployed a new `Artificial` contract owned by the minter, and recorded it in the `isArtificial` registry. Collected mint proceeds can be swept by the artist via `collect()`.
risks: No upgradeability — contract logic is permanent and cannot be patched
The artist alone can call collect(), which sweeps the entire ETH balance to the artist
